description: Register a webhook on the user’s account after explicit confirmation. Listing events will be sent to this URL. Requires Pro (including a free trial) and write:account. The signing secret is returned only once; keep it private.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

url.description: Public HTTPS destination for signed events.

name: create_webhook
title: Create a webhook destination
